_provenance.warning: NOT CAPTURED FROM FRED. NOT ECONOMIC DATA. Do not read any number here as a measurement of anything. The values 1.1 / 2.2 / 3.3 / 4.4 were chosen precisely because no real macro series looks like that.
_provenance.why_not_captured: P3.8 was built with no FRED API key provisioned. Every FRED endpoint requires a key (verified live on 2026-08-01: a keyless GET of fred/series/observations answers HTTP 400 'Variable api_key is not set'), so no real multi-vintage response could be recorded. Rather than invent a payload and let it pass as real, this file is labelled as constructed and its only job is to exercise temporal logic.
_provenance.schema_fidelity: Envelope and row shape follow the documented fred/series/observations JSON response for output_type=1 ('Observations by Real-Time Period'). Per ALFRED's Download Data Help: realtime_start is 'the first vintage date for which a data value is the latest revision available' and realtime_end 'the last'. The real-time periods below are contiguous and non-overlapping per observation date, which is what that definition requires.
_provenance.scenario: Observation date 2024-01-01 is revised twice (three vintages); observation date 2024-04-01 has a single vintage released later. This is the revision case the whole connector exists to get right: an as_of before a revision must return the superseded value.
_provenance.captured_counterpart: observations-gnpca-docs-example.json is genuinely published FRED output and pins the same envelope.
